en.abdullah-al-shahin: (10) Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Sa’eed narrated from al-Qassim bin Muhammad bin al-Hasan bin Hazim from Obayss bin Hisham from Abdullah bin Jibilla from Ahmad bin al-Harith from al-Mufadhdhal bin Umar that Abu Abdullah as-Sadiq (as) had said:
“The man of this matter will recite in one of his (two) disappearances, “
So I fled from you when I feared you, then my Lord granted me wisdom and made me of the messengers.”
